description: The tools window (the tools panel popped out of the main window) may call only the commands the panel uses: the selection summary and applying items to the selected lines, the setup tables as the panel's compact tabs show them (their full editors, charges, credits, info, settings and the baseline are the Budget Setup window's, capabilities/setup.json), a line's note and the list of notes, the tag presets and line blocks (saving, applying, inserting and arranging them), the Find tab (finding and replacing), the personal setup library (its view, copying items to and from it, its folders, and picking its file in Rust's own dialogs: no path comes from the page) and its Setup packs section (listing packs, exporting and importing them through Rust's own dialogs, showing the Packs folder), the History tab's list of undo steps (jumping and saving a step go to the main window), the Explain tab's explanation of a total, the Overtime tab (its preview, writing into a line, its saved patterns), the Actuals tab (listing, editing, reassigning and deleting transactions, removing an import, setting an account's estimate to complete; importing is the main window's File menu), and get_view; and send and receive events between the two windows. No file, save, undo or window commands: it passes those keys to the main window.
